Difference equals 900 minus 675, which is 225 square centimetres.

EXT_G5_FP_2024_034.q: Shraddha is facing East. She turns 135 degrees in clockwise direction, and then 315 degrees in anti-clockwise direction. In which direction is she facing now?
hints: Clockwise from East goes to South, at 90 degrees, then South-West, at 135 degrees. Turning 315 degrees anti-clockwise is the same as a small turn the other way: 360 degrees minus 315 degrees.
Turning x degrees anti-clockwise is the same as turning 360 degrees minus x degrees, clockwise.
steps: East, plus 135 degrees clockwise, gives South-West.
315 degrees anti-clockwise equals 360 degrees minus 315 degrees, which is 45 degrees clockwise.
South-West, plus 45 degrees clockwise, gives West.

EXT_G5_FP_2024_035.q: Solve: 4 x minus 5, all over 5, equals 2 x plus 3, all over 3. And find the value of x?
hints: Cross-multiply: multiply the top of the left fraction by the bottom of the right one, and the other way round.
Cross multiplication: A over b equals c over d, so A times d equals b times c.
steps: 3 times, open bracket, 4 x minus 5, close bracket, equals 5 times, open bracket, 2 x plus 3, close bracket.
12 x minus 15 equals 10 x plus 15.
12 x minus 10 x equals 15 plus 15, so 2 x equals 30.
x equals 15.

EXT_G5_FP_2024_036.q: Which set of signs of operation should be replaced in the boxes so that the equation is true: 12, blank, 6, blank, 3, blank, 14, equals 16?
hints: Try each option and follow BODMAS: multiply or divide first, then add or subtract.
Test each option one at a time. Multiplication and division happens before addition and subtraction.
steps: Option A: 12 times 6, minus 3 divided by 14, equals 72 minus 0.21 and so on. That does not work.
Option B: 12 minus 6 divided by 3 plus 14, equals 12 minus 2 plus 14, which is 24. That does not work.
Option C: 12 times 6 divided by 3, plus 14, equals 24 plus 14, which is 38. That does not work.
Option D: 12 plus 6 times 3 minus 14, equals 12 plus 18 minus 14, which is 16. That works.

EXT_G5_FP_2024_038.q: Calculate Simple Interest on 4250 rupees for 5 years at 8 percent per year rate of interest.
hints: Use simple interest equals principal times rate times time, divided by 100. Try finding 1 percent of 4250 first.
Simple interest equals principal times rate times time, divided by 100.
steps: 1 percent of 4250 equals 42.5.
Per year at 8 percent, that is 8 times 42.5, which is 340.
For 5 years, that is 5 times 340, which is 1700 rupees.

EXT_G5_FP_2024_039.q: What is the sum of all one-digit factors of 72?
hints: List the factors of 72 in pairs: 1 times 72, 2 times 36, and so on. Then pick only the ones below 10.
The factor pairs of 72 are 1 times 72, 2 times 36, 3 times 24, 4 times 18, 6 times 12, and 8 times 9.
steps: All the factors are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 12, 18, 24, 36 and 72.
The one-digit factors are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 9.
The sum is 1 plus 2 plus 3 plus 4 plus 6 plus 8 plus 9, which equals 33.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_001.q: If you add all one-digit odd numbers, and multiply the sum by the greatest two-digit prime number, what would be the place value of the digit in the hundreds place?
hints: One-digit odd numbers are 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9. Add them, then multiply by the greatest two-digit prime. It is more than 90.
The hundreds place is the 3rd digit from the right.
steps: The sum is 1 plus 3 plus 5 plus 7 plus 9, which equals 25.
The greatest two-digit prime is 97.
25 times 97 equals 2425.
The digit in the hundreds place is 4. So the place value is 400.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_002.q: The circumference of a circle is equal to the perimeter of a square. If the area of the circle is 616 square centimetres, find the area of the square.
hints: Use the circle's area, pi times r times r, with pi equal to 22 over 7, to find r. Then find the circumference, and share it among the 4 equal sides of the square.
Circle area equals pi r squared. Circumference equals 2 pi r. Square perimeter equals 4 times side.
steps: 22 over 7, times r squared, equals 616. So r squared equals 616 times 7, divided by 22, which is 196. So r equals 14 centimetres.
Circumference equals 2, times 22 over 7, times 14, which is 88 centimetres.
Square perimeter equals 88. So the side equals 88 divided by 4, which is 22 centimetres.
Area equals 22 times 22, which is 484 square centimetres.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_003.q: 1 gross of cricket balls costs 32,400 rupees. What will be the cost of 85 cricket balls?
hints: 1 gross is 144 items. Find the cost of one ball, then multiply by 85.
1 dozen is 12, and 1 gross is 12 dozen, which is 144.
steps: The cost of 1 ball is 32,400 divided by 144, which is 225 rupees.
The cost of 85 balls is 85 times 225, which is 19,125 rupees.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_004.q: What will be the remainder when the product of all one-digit odd numbers is divided by 18?
hints: One-digit odd numbers: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9. Multiply them all, then divide by 18 and see what is left over.
Remainder equals Dividend minus, open bracket, Divisor times whole-number quotient, close bracket.
steps: 1 times 3 times 5 times 7 times 9, equals 945.
945 divided by 18: 18 times 52 equals 936.
Remainder equals 945 minus 936, which is 9.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_005.q: What percent of 80 should be added to 80 so as to get the sum equal to the square of 12?
hints: What is 12 times 12? How much extra do you need on top of 80? Then ask: that extra is what percent of 80?
Percent equals part divided by whole, times 100.
steps: Square of 12 equals 144.
Extra needed equals 144 minus 80, which is 64.
64 divided by 80, times 100, equals 80 percent.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_006.q: An article is sold at a loss of 80 rupees. If the article was sold at 375 rupees the profit would have been twice the loss. Find at what price the article was sold.
hints: Profit would be twice the loss, which is 2 times 80, that is 160 rupees. Use that to find the cost price first.
Cost price equals selling price minus profit. And selling price at a loss equals cost price minus loss.
steps: Profit would be 2 times 80, which is 160 rupees, at a selling price of 375 rupees.
Cost price equals 375 minus 160, which is 215 rupees.
The original selling price, at a loss of 80 rupees, equals 215 minus 80, which is 135 rupees.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_007.q: Find the rate of interest if 28500 rupees amounts to 38760 rupees in three years.
hints: Amount equals principal plus interest. Find the interest first, then use rate equals simple interest times 100, divided by, open bracket, principal times time, close bracket.
Rate equals simple interest times 100, divided by, open bracket, principal times time, close bracket.
steps: Simple interest equals 38,760 minus 28500, which is 10,260 rupees.
Rate equals 10,260 times 100, divided by, open bracket, 28,500 times 3, close bracket. That is 1,026,000 divided by 85500, which is 12 percent per annum.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_008.q: A train crosses a pole in 28 seconds, running at a speed of 108 kilometres per hour. Find the length of the train.
hints: Change the speed from kilometres per hour to metres per second first. Crossing a pole means the train covers exactly its own length.
Kilometres per hour to metres per second: multiply by 5 over 18. Length equals speed times time.
steps: 108 kilometres per hour equals 108 times 5, divided by 18, which is 30 metres per second.
Length equals 30 times 28, which is 840 metres.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_009.q: How many three-digit numbers are divisible by 5, 2 and 8?
hints: Find the L C M of 5, 2 and 8. A number divisible by all three is a multiple of it. Then list the three-digit multiples.
To count the multiples between two numbers: divide the last one by the L C M, then subtract the number of multiples below the range.
steps: The L C M of 5, 2 and 8 is 40.
The smallest 3 digit multiple of 40 is 120, which is 40 times 3. The largest is 960, which is 40 times 24.
The multiples run from 40 times 3, up to 40 times 24. So that is 24 minus 3, plus 1, which is 22.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_010.q: The sum of two numbers is 92 and their difference is 14. Find the square of the greater number.
hints: If you add the sum and the difference, the smaller number cancels out and you get twice the greater number.
Greater number equals Sum plus Difference, divided by 2. Smaller number equals Sum minus Difference, divided by 2.
steps: Greater equals, open bracket, 92 plus 14, close bracket, divided by 2. That is 106 divided by 2, which is 53.
Smaller equals, open bracket, 92 minus 14, close bracket, divided by 2, which is 39. Check: 53 plus 39 equals 92. That works.
Square of greater equals 53 times 53, which is 2809.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_011.q: What is the angle between the hour and minute hand at 9 33 p m?
hints: Hour hand equals 9 times 30, plus a bit more for the 33 minutes, at half a degree per minute. Minute hand equals 33 times 6.
Hour hand angle equals hours times 30, plus minutes times 0.5. Minute hand angle equals minutes times 6.
steps: Hour hand: 9 times 30, plus 33 times 0.5. That is 270 plus 16.5, which is 286.5 degrees.
Minute hand: 33 times 6, which is 198 degrees.
The angle between them equals 286.5 minus 198, which is 88.5 degrees.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_012.q: The area of a rectangle is 468 square centimetres. If the breadth of the rectangle is 18 centimetres, find the perimeter of the rectangle.
hints: Use area equals length times breadth to find the length first. Then use the perimeter formula.
Length equals area divided by breadth. Perimeter equals 2 times, length plus breadth.
steps: Length equals 468 divided by 18, which is 26 centimetres.
Perimeter equals 2 times, 26 plus 18. That is 2 times 44, which is 88 centimetres.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_013.q: What is the sum of all natural two-digit odd numbers less than 40?
hints: Two-digit odd numbers start at 11, and go 11, 13, 15, and so on, up to 39. Count how many there are, then use the pairing trick for the sum.
The sum equals the number of terms, divided by 2, times, open bracket, first plus last, close bracket. The number of terms equals, open bracket, last minus first, close bracket, divided by d, plus 1.
steps: The numbers are 11, 13, 15, and so on, up to 39. The jump, d, is 2.
The count is, open bracket, 39 minus 11, close bracket, divided by 2, plus 1, which equals 15.
The sum is 15 divided by 2, times, open bracket, 11 plus 39, close bracket. That is 15 times 25, which equals 375.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_014.q: 3 over 4, 5 over 6, and 4 over 5. Out of the given fractions, what is the difference between the greatest and the smallest fraction?
hints: Make all three fractions have the same denominator, the L C M of 4, 6 and 5. Then compare the tops.
To compare fractions, convert them to the same denominator.
steps: The L C M of 4, 6 and 5 is 60.
3 over 4 equals 45 over 60. 5 over 6 equals 50 over 60. 4 over 5 equals 48 over 60.
The greatest is 50 over 60. The smallest is 45 over 60.
The difference is 5 over 60, which equals 1 over 12.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_015.q: Find the sum of the 12th even number serially coming after 99, and the 18th even number serially coming before 99.
hints: The first even number after 99 is 100. The first even number before 99 is 98. Then count in 2s.
The nth even number after 99 is 100, plus, open bracket, n minus 1, close bracket, times 2. The nth even number before 99 is 98, minus, open bracket, n minus 1, close bracket, times 2.
steps: The 12th even number after 99 is 100, plus 11 times 2. That is 100 plus 22, which equals 122.
The 18th even number before 99 is 98, minus 17 times 2. That is 98 minus 34, which equals 64.
The sum is 122 plus 64, which equals 186.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_016.q: The L C M and H C F of two numbers are 672 and 12 respectively. If one of the numbers is 84, find the other number.
hints: L C M times H C F equals the product of the two numbers. Multiply 672 and 12, then divide by 84.
L C M times H C F equals the first number times the second number.
steps: 672 times 12 is 8064.
The other number is 8064 divided by 84, which is 96.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_017.q: If p equals 7, and q equals 2 p minus 9. Which of the following expressions has the greatest value?
hints: Find q first, use p equals 7. Then work out all four expressions and compare.
Always find the missing letter first, then substitute.
steps: q equals 2 times 7, minus 9. That is 14 minus 9, which is 5.
Option A: 14 minus 15 plus 5 equals 4.
Option B: 20 minus 14 equals 6.
Option C: 7 plus 5 minus 12 equals 0.
Option D: 35 minus 35 plus 3 equals 3.
Greatest is 6, which comes from 4 q minus 2 p.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_018.q: If 12 over 52 equals y over 13, which equals m over 39. Find the value of m minus y.
hints: Simplify 12 over 52 by dividing top and bottom by 4. Then match the denominators 13 and 39.
Equivalent fractions: same multiplier on top and bottom.
steps: 12 over 52 equals 3 over 13, dividing by 4. So y equals 3.
3 over 13 equals 9 over 39, multiplying by 3. So m equals 9.
m minus y equals 9 minus 3, which is 6.

hints: Group the numbers with a plus together, and the numbers with a minus together. Then subtract one total from the other.
a minus b plus c minus d, equals, open bracket, a plus c, close bracket, minus, open bracket, b plus d, close bracket.
steps: Plus group: 2.007 plus 16.317 equals 18.324.
Minus group: 14.659 plus 2.042 equals 16.701.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_020.q: 6.5 percent of 800 equals 8 percent of 250 plus M. Find the value of M.
hints: Work out each percentage separately: 1 percent of 800 is 8, and 1 percent of 250 is 2.5.
X percent of N equals x times, N divided by 100.
steps: 6.5 percent of 800 equals 6.5 times 8, which is 52.
8 percent of 250 equals 8 times 2.5, which is 20.
52 equals 20 plus M, so M equals 52 minus 20, which is 32.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_021.q: 97 added to which of the following options will give you a square number?
hints: Add 97 to each option, and check whether it is a perfect square. Use 30 squared is 900, 31 squared is 961, and 32 squared is 1024, as markers.
Quick filter: a perfect square never ends in 2, 3, 7 or 8.
steps: 852 plus 97 equals 949. That is between 30 squared and 31 squared, so it is not a square.
768 plus 97 equals 865. That is between 29 squared and 30 squared, so it is not a square.
489 plus 97 equals 586. That is between 24 squared and 25 squared, so it is not a square.
927 plus 97 equals 1024, which is 32 squared. Yes.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_022.q: What would be the sum of the first 8 terms of the given series: 7, 11, 15, 19, and so on?
hints: Write all 8 terms. Pair the first with the last, the second with the second-last, and so on. Each pair adds to the same number!
The sum of n terms equals n divided by 2, times, open bracket, first plus last, close bracket.
steps: First plus last is 7 plus 35, which equals 42.
The sum is 8 divided by 2, times 42. That is 4 times 42, which equals 168.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_023.q: Simplify: 200 minus, open bracket, 20 times 7, plus 150 divided by 3, close bracket, plus 8 times 2 divided by 8, equals what?
hints: Brackets first! Inside the bracket, do multiplication and division before addition. Outside, do 8 times 2 divided by 8 from left to right.
B first, then D and M left to right, then A and S left to right.
steps: Bracket: 20 times 7 equals 140 and 150 divided by 3 equals 50, so 140 plus 50 equals 190.
8 times 2 divided by 8 equals 16 divided by 8, which is 2.
200 minus 190 plus 2 equals 10 plus 2, which is 12.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_024.q: By selling an article for 78 rupees, a loss of 35 percent is made. For how much should the article be sold to make a profit of 15 percent?
hints: A 35 percent loss means 78 rupees is only 65 percent of the cost price. Find cost price, then take 115 percent of it.

Selling price equals cost price times, open bracket, 100 minus loss percent, close bracket, divided by 100. So cost price equals selling price times 100, divided by, open bracket, 100 minus loss percent, close bracket.
steps: 65 percent of cost price equals 78, so 1 percent equals 1.2, so cost price equals 120 rupees.
For 15 percent profit: selling price equals 115 percent of 120. That is 115 times 1.2, which is 138 rupees.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_025.q: 15 men can do a work in 28 days. If the work has to be done in 20 days, how many more men will be required?
hints: Fewer days means more men. The total work, which is men times days, stays the same. And the question asks for more men, not the total.
Men times days is constant. This is inverse proportion.
steps: The total work is 15 times 28, which is 420 man days.
Men needed for 20 days: 420 divided by 20, which is 21.
More men needed: 21 minus 15, which is 6.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_026.q: What amount will you have to invest to earn simple interest of 280 rupees per month at 15 percent per year rate of interest?
hints: The rate is per year but the interest is per month. Convert 280 rupees a month into a yearly interest first.
Principal equals simple interest times 100, divided by, open bracket, rate times time, close bracket.
steps: Interest in 1 year equals 280 times 12, which is 3360 rupees.
Principal equals 3360 times 100, divided by, open bracket, 15 times 1, close bracket. That is 336000 divided by 15, which is 22,400 rupees.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_027.q: To cover a distance of 432 kilometres, travelling at a speed of 24 metres per second, how much time will be required?
hints: The distance is in kilometres, but the speed is in metres per second. Make the units match: change 24 metres per second to kilometres per hour.
Metres per second to kilometres per hour: multiply by 18 over 5. Time equals distance divided by speed.
steps: 24 metres per second equals 24 times 18, divided by 5, which is 86.4 kilometres per hour.
Time equals 432 divided by 86.4, which is 5 hours.
5 hours is not among options A to C. So, none of these.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_028.q: If 4 x plus 3 equals 22. Find the value of 12 x plus 3.
hints: Notice that 12 x is 3 times 4 x. You may not even need to find x!
If you know 4 x, then 12 x equals 3 times 4 x.
steps: 4 x plus 3 equals 22, so 4 x equals 19.
12 x equals 3 times 4 x, which is 3 times 19, which is 57.
12 x plus 3 equals 57 plus 3, which is 60.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_029.q: What is the sum of the supplementary and complementary angle of 58 degrees?
hints: Complementary angles add up to 90 degrees. Supplementary angles add up to 180 degrees. Find both partners of 58 degrees, then add them.
Complementary equals 90 degrees minus the angle. Supplementary equals 180 degrees minus the angle.
steps: Complementary angle equals 90 degrees minus 58 degrees, which is 32 degrees.
Supplementary angle equals 180 degrees minus 58 degrees, which is 122 degrees.
Sum equals 32 degrees plus 122 degrees, which is 154 degrees.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_030.q: Product of 7.2 and 3.9 is how much more than the smallest 2-digit prime number?
hints: Multiply 72 times 39 first, ignore the dots, then put the decimal back. The smallest two-digit prime is bigger than 10.
Decimal places in the answer equals total decimal places in the numbers multiplied. 1 plus 1 equals 2.
steps: 72 times 39 equals 2808. With 2 decimal places, that is 28.08.
Smallest 2-digit prime equals 11.
28.08 minus 11 equals 17.08.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_031.q: Which option of the following is correct?
hints: Calculate each square and add. Use the last digit: the last digit of the sum must match the last digit of the answer given.
The last digit of a square comes only from the last digit: 18 squared ends in 4, and 23 squared ends in 9. 4 plus 9 is 13, so the sum ends in 3.
steps: 7 squared plus 11 squared is 49 plus 121, which equals 170, not 150.
9 squared plus 16 squared is 81 plus 256, which equals 337, not 327.
19 squared plus 27 squared is 361 plus 729, which equals 1090, not 1190.
18 squared plus 23 squared is 324 plus 529, which equals 853. Correct.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_032.q: Find the 8th term of the series: 197, 193, 185, 173, 157, and so on.
hints: The gap between terms is not constant. Write down the gaps: 4, 8, 12, and so on. Do you see a pattern in the gaps?
When gaps themselves form a pattern, keep extending the gaps: minus 4, minus 8, minus 12, minus 16, minus 20, and so on.
steps: The gaps: from 197 to 193 is minus 4. From 193 to 185 is minus 8. From 185 to 173 is minus 12. From 173 to 157 is minus 16.
The gaps grow by 4 each time: the next gaps are minus 20, minus 24, minus 28.
The 6th term is 157 minus 20, which is 137. The 7th is 137 minus 24, which is 113. The 8th is 113 minus 28, which is 85.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_033.q: A three-digit number, blank, blank, 7, is multiplied by a three-digit number, blank, blank, 6. Which of the following can be their product, if blank represents a digit, not necessarily the same?
hints: Check the last digit, 7 times 6, then check the smallest possible product, 107 times 106, and the largest, 997 times 996.
Smallest product equals 107 times 106, which is 11342. Largest product equals 997 times 996, which is 993,012.
steps: Ones digit: 7 times 6 equals 42, so the product ends in 2. That removes 457647, which ends in 7.
Smallest possible equals 107 times 106, which is 11342, so 11332 is too small.
Largest possible equals 997 times 996, which is 993012, so 994312 is too big.
Only 353362 is left, and it works. It equals 547 times 646.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_034.q: Square P Q R S has an area of 196 square centimetres. A rectangle A B C D has an area four times the area of this square. Which of the following can be the sides of the rectangle?
hints: Find the rectangle's area: 4 times 196. Then multiply the two sides in each option, and see which gives that area.
Area of a rectangle equals length times breadth.
steps: Rectangle area equals 4 times 196, which is 784 square centimetres.
44 times 16 is 704, not a match. 52 times 18 is 936, not a match. 28 times 36 is 1008, not a match.
56 times 14 is 784. That matches.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_035.q: Insert the bracket in the correct place, so that the equation will be true with respect to the BODMAS rule: 192 divided by 12 times 3, minus 4, plus 13, equals 19.
hints: Without brackets the answer is 61. To get 19 the divisor must become bigger. Try each bracket and see.
A bracket changes the order: whatever is inside is solved first.
steps: Option B: 192 divided by 36, minus 4 plus 13, equals 5.33 and so on, minus 4 plus 13. That does not work.
Option C: 192 divided by 12 times 12 equals 192. That does not work.
Option D: 192 divided by, open bracket, 12 times 3 minus 4, close bracket, plus 13, equals 192 divided by 32 plus 13, that is 6 plus 13, which is 19. That works.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_037.q: If A equals 17, and b equals, open bracket, A minus 1, close bracket, divided by 2, and c equals b plus 3. Find the value of A squared, minus c squared, plus b squared.
hints: Find b from A, then c from b. Then work out each square and use plus and minus from left to right.
Order of finding: A, then b, then c.
steps: b equals, open bracket, 17 minus 1, close bracket, divided by 2. That is 16 divided by 2, which is 8.
c equals 8 plus 3, which is 11.
A squared equals 289, c squared equals 121, b squared equals 64.
289 minus 121 plus 64 equals 168 plus 64, which is 232.

EXT_G5_FP_2025_040.q: Find simple interest if 16000 rupees is invested for 18 months at 8 percent per year.
hints: Time must be in years. How many years is 18 months?
18 months equals 1.5 years. Simple interest equals principal times rate times time, divided by 100.
steps: Time equals 18 divided by 12, which is 1.5 years.
1 percent of 16000 equals 160. At 8 percent for 1 year, that is 1280.
For 1.5 years: 1280 times 1.5 equals 1920 rupees.

EXT_G5_WS_01_001.q: How many tens form six hundred hundreds?
hints: First figure out what six hundred hundreds means as a single number.
Six hundred hundreds is 600 times 100, which is 60,000. Now divide by 10 to find how many tens.
A simpler example: how many tens in two hundred? 200 divided by 10 equals 20 tens. Now do 60,000 divided by 10.
steps: Find the value of six hundred hundreds.
Divide by 10 to convert to tens.

EXT_G5_WS_01_002.q: Which of the following digits has the same place value and face value, irrespective of the place it is in?
hints: Think about what happens when you put each digit in different places: tens, hundreds, and so on.
Place value equals the digit, times the position value. Face value is the digit itself. Which digit always gives the same result?
Try 0 in the tens place. Its place value is 0 times 10, which is 0, and its face value is 0. They match! For 9 in the tens place, 90 is not equal to 9.
steps: Face value is the digit itself. Place value equals the digit, times the position value.
For 0: 0 times any position is 0. The face value is 0. They always match.
So 0 always has the same place value and face value.

EXT_G5_WS_01_003.q: If the place value of a digit is an odd number, which place is that digit in?
hints: Think about what happens when you multiply any digit by 10, 100 or 1000. Is the result ever odd?
The tens place value is always a multiple of 10, so it is even. The hundreds place value is always a multiple of 100, so it is even.
Try 3 in the tens place: that gives 30, which is even. 7 in the units place gives 7, which is odd. Only the units place can give odd values.
steps: The place value in the tens place is the digit times 10, which is always even.
The place value in the hundreds or thousands place is the digit times 100 or 1000, which is always even.
The place value in the units place is the digit times 1, which is the digit itself. This can be odd.
Only the units place can produce an odd place value.

EXT_G5_WS_01_004.q: In the number 69512, what is the difference between the digits that have the greatest and the least place values?
hints: Identify which digit is in the highest place, the ten-thousands, and which is in the lowest, the units.
In 69512, the digit in the ten-thousands place is 6, and the digit in the units place is 2.
A simpler example: in 853, the digit in the hundreds place, the highest, is 8. The digit in the units place, the lowest, is 3. The difference is 8 minus 3, which is 5.
steps: The digit in the greatest place, the ten-thousands, is 6.
The digit in the least place, the units, is 2.
Find the difference: 6 minus 2 equals 4.

EXT_G5_WS_01_005.q: In the number 76025, how many times is the place value of 6 to that of 2?
hints: Find the place value of 6, and the place value of 2, separately in 76025.
6 is in the thousands place, so its place value is 6000. 2 is in the tens place, so its place value is 20.
Try this: in 5030, the place value of 5 is 5000, and the place value of 3 is 30. The ratio is 5000 divided by 30.
steps: The place value of 6, in the thousands place: 6 times 1000 equals 6000.
The place value of 2, in the tens place: 2 times 10 equals 20.
Divide: 6000 divided by 20 equals 300.

EXT_G5_WS_01_006.q: The digit 8 is used twice in each of the following numbers. In which number is the place value of one 8, a thousand times that of the other 8?
hints: For one 8 to be 1000 times the other, the two 8s must be exactly 3 place-positions apart.
3 positions apart means units and thousands, or tens and ten-thousands.

Check 85168. 8 is in the ten-thousands place, worth 80000, and in the units place, worth 8. 80000 divided by 8 is 10000. Check 68815. 8 is in the thousands place, worth 8000, and the hundreds place, worth 800. 8000 divided by 800 is 10.
steps: Check 68815. The 8s are in the thousands place, worth 8000, and the hundreds place, worth 800. 8000 divided by 800 is 10, not 1000.
Check 65818. The 8s are in the hundreds place, worth 800, and the units place, worth 8. 800 divided by 8 is 100, not 1000.
Check 81586. The 8s are in the ten-thousands place, worth 80000, and the tens place, worth 80. 80000 divided by 80 is 1000. That works.
This is the one where one 8 is 1000 times the other: 81586.

EXT_G5_WS_01_007.q: In which of the following is the place value of one 3, a hundred times that of the other 3 in the same number?
hints: For one 3 to be 100 times the other, the two 3s must be exactly 2 place-positions apart.
2 positions apart means units and hundreds, or tens and thousands, or hundreds and ten-thousands.
Check each number: find where the two 3s are, and compare their place values.
steps: Check 134639. There is a 3 in the ten-thousands place, worth 30000, and a 3 in the tens place, worth 30. 30000 divided by 30 is 1000, not 100.
Check 752339. There is a 3 in the hundreds place, worth 300, and a 3 in the tens place, worth 30. 300 divided by 30 is 10, not 100.
Check 863135. There is a 3 in the thousands place, worth 3000, and a 3 in the tens place, worth 30. 3000 divided by 30 is 100. That works.
This is the answer: 863135.

EXT_G5_WS_01_008.q: 7, star, star, 19 is a five-digit number. The stars denote the same digit, and the difference between their place values is 5400. Find the digit in place of the star.
hints: The two stars are in the thousands and hundreds places of 7, star, star, 19.
If the digit is d, place values are d times 1000 and d times 100. Difference equals d times 1000 minus d times 100, which is 900 d.
Try: If d equals 5, difference equals 900 times 5, which is 4500. If d equals 6, difference equals 900 times 6, which is 5400.
steps: The two stars are in thousands and hundreds places.
Place value difference equals d times 1000 minus d times 100, which is 900 d.
Set equal to 5400. 900 d equals 5400.
Solve for d. d equals 5400 over 900, which is 6.

EXT_G5_WS_01_009.q: In the five-digit number 3, star, 8, star, 2, the digits in place of the stars are the same, and the difference between their place values is 6930. Find the repeated digit.
hints: Read the question carefully. This tests your understanding of place value algebra. Identify what information is given and what you need to find.
Write down the key formula or relationship for place value algebra. Think step by step about how to connect the given values to the answer.
Try a simpler version of the problem first, then apply the same method to the actual numbers.
steps: The stars are in thousands and tens places.
Difference equals d times 1000 minus d times 10, which is 990 d.
Set equal to 6930. 990 d equals 6930.
Solve for d. d equals 6930 over 990, which is 7.

EXT_G5_WS_01_010.q: In the five-digit number 6, star, 8, star, 4, the star represents the same digit. Which of the following can be the difference between the place values of the repeated digit?
hints: The stars are in the thousands and tens places of 6, star, 8, star, 4.
If digit is d, difference equals d times 1000 minus d times 10, which is 990 d. Which option is divisible by 990?
Check: 3030 divided by 990 equals 3.06, and so on. Hmm. Let me re-examine positions.
steps: The stars are in the thousands and tens places.
Difference equals d times 1000 minus d times 10, which is 990 d.
Check which option is a multiple of 990: 3030 divided by 990 is about 3.06.

Wait, rechecking. If the star is in ten-thousands and hundreds: no, 6 is in ten-thousands. If positions are 4th and 2nd, thousands and tens, then 990 d. 990 times 1 equals 990. 990 times 2 equals 1980. 990 times 3 equals 2970.

EXT_G5_WS_01_011.q: What is the successor of the greatest four-digit number formed by using the digits 1, 5, 0 and 8, each only once?
hints: First, form the greatest four-digit number using 1, 5, 0 and 8, each once.
To make the greatest number, arrange the digits in descending order: 8, 5, 1, 0. That gives 8510.
Try this: the greatest 3-digit number with 3, 7 and 1 is 731. Its successor is 732.
steps: Arrange the digits in descending order for the greatest number: 8, 5, 1, 0. That gives 8510.
Find the successor, by adding 1: 8510 plus 1 equals 8511.

EXT_G5_WS_01_012.q: Which digit is exactly in the middle of the greatest odd number formed by using the digits 5, 8, 0, 7 and 4, each only once?
hints: First form the greatest odd number with 5, 8, 0, 7 and 4, each used once. It must end in an odd digit.

For the greatest odd number, start with the largest digits, and end with the largest odd digit. The options for the units place are 5 or 7. With 5 at the end: 87405. With 7 at the end: 85407. Compare: 87405 is greater than 85407.

The greatest is 87405. The middle digit, the 3rd, is 4. Check again: 8, 7, 4, 0, 5. The middle is 4. But one option is 5. Ending in 7 gives 85407, with middle 4. Ending in 5 gives 87405, with middle 4.
steps: The greatest odd number must end in an odd digit, 5 or 7.
Try ending in 5. The remaining digits, 8, 7, 4, 0, in descending order, give 87405.
Try ending in 7. The remaining digits, 8, 5, 4, 0, in descending order, give 85407.
87405 is greater than 85407, so the greatest odd number is 87405.
The middle digit, the 3rd, of 87405 is 4.

EXT_G5_WS_01_013.q: What is the place value of 7, in the smallest even number formed by using the digits 2, 7, 3, 9 and 6, each only once?
hints: Form the smallest even number using 2, 7, 3, 9 and 6. It must end in an even digit.
The even digits available are 2 and 6. For the smallest number, start with the smallest digits. If it ends in 2, you get 36792. If it ends in 6, you get 23796.
23796 is less than 36792, so the smallest even number is 23796. Where is 7? In the hundreds place. Its place value is 700.
steps: The smallest even number must end in an even digit: 2 or 6.
Ending in 2, arrange the rest in ascending order. That gives 36792.
Ending in 6, arrange the rest in ascending order. That gives 23796.
23796 is less than 36792, so the smallest even number is 23796.
7 is in the hundreds place. Its place value is 700.

EXT_G5_WS_01_014.q: How many two-digit even numbers have an odd digit in the tens place?
hints: Two-digit even numbers end in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8. That is 5 choices. The tens digit must be odd.
The odd digits for the tens place are 1, 3, 5, 7, 9. That is 5 choices. The even digits for the units place are 0, 2, 4, 6, 8. That is 5 choices.
Try this: how many two-digit numbers have 1 in the tens place, and are even? 10, 12, 14, 16, 18. That is 5 numbers.
steps: The odd digits for the tens place are 1, 3, 5, 7, 9. That is 5 choices.
The even digits for the units place are 0, 2, 4, 6, 8. That is 5 choices.
The total is 5 times 5. And 5 times 5 equals 25.

EXT_G5_WS_01_015.q: Using the digits 7, 0, 3 and 9, each only once, how many distinct four-digit numbers can be formed?
hints: For a four-digit number, the first digit cannot be 0.
The thousands place has 3 choices: 7, 3 or 9, but not 0. The remaining 3 digits can go in any order in the other 3 places.
Try this with the digits 1, 0 and 2, making three-digit numbers. The first digit has 2 choices, 1 or 2. Then 2 factorial for the rest. That is 2 times 2, which equals 4.
steps: The thousands place cannot be 0, so it has 3 choices: 7, 3 or 9.
The remaining 3 digits fill 3 places in any order. 3 factorial equals 6 arrangements.
The total of four-digit numbers: 3 times 6 equals 18.

EXT_G5_WS_01_016.q: How many four-digit numbers less than 5000 can be formed using the digits 2, 5, 0 and 8, each only once?
hints: For a number less than 5000, the thousands digit must be less than 5.
From the digits 2, 5, 0 and 8, the digits less than 5 that can be in the thousands place: only 2. Not 0, since that makes a 3-digit number.
With 2 in the thousands place, the remaining digits, 5, 0 and 8, go in 3 factorial, which is 6 arrangements.
steps: The thousands digit must be less than 5, and not 0. Only 2 works.
The remaining digits, 5, 0 and 8, can be arranged in 3 factorial ways. 3 factorial equals 6.
The total numbers: 1 times 6 equals 6.

EXT_G5_WS_01_017.q: In a queue, Anay is 10th from the beginning and Vinay is 8th from the end. If 5 people are standing between Anay and Vinay, how many people are there in all in this queue?
hints: Draw the queue. Anay is at position 10 from the front. Vinay is at position 8 from the back.
People equals Anay's position, plus people between them, plus Vinay's position from the end, minus overlaps if any. Total equals 10 plus 5 plus 8, which is 23.
Simpler: If Ram is 3rd from front, Shyam is 2nd from back, and 1 person is between them: total equals 3 plus 1 plus 2, which is 6.
steps: Anay is 10th from front. That means 9 people before Anay, plus Anay.
5 people between Anay and Vinay.
Vinay is 8th from end. That means Vinay, plus 7 people after.
Total equals 10 plus 5 plus 8, which is 23.

EXT_G5_WS_01_018.q: Which of the following is the 23rd even number prior to 105?
hints: 105 is odd. The first even number before 105 is 104. Each subsequent even number is 2 less.
The nth even number before an odd number equals the odd number, minus, open bracket, 2 n minus 1, close bracket.
Try the 3rd even number before 11: 10, 8 and 6. That's 11 minus 5, which equals 6. The formula gives 11 minus, open bracket, 2 times 3, minus 1, close bracket. That is 11 minus 5, which equals 6.
steps: 105 is odd. The nth even number before an odd number M is M minus, open bracket, 2 n minus 1, close bracket.
Substitute M equals 105, and n equals 23. We get 105 minus, open bracket, 2 times 23, minus 1, close bracket, which is 105 minus 45.
Calculate: 105 minus 45 equals 60.

EXT_G5_WS_01_019.q: What is the difference between the even numbers coming serially before and after the odd number 'Q'?
hints: If Q is odd, the even number just before Q is Q minus 1 and just after Q is Q plus 1.
Difference equals, open bracket, Q plus 1, close bracket, minus, open bracket, Q minus 1, close bracket, which is 2.
Try: Q equals 7. Even before 7 equals 6. Even after 7 equals 8. Difference equals 8 minus 6, which is 2.
steps: Even number before odd Q is Q minus 1.
Even number after odd Q is Q plus 1.
The difference is, open bracket, Q plus 1, close bracket, minus, open bracket, Q minus 1, close bracket, which is 2.

EXT_G5_WS_01_020.q: If K is an even number, which is the 12th odd number before it?
hints: The first odd number before even K is K minus 1. The next is K minus 3, then K minus 5, and so on.
The nth odd number before even K is K minus, open bracket, 2 n minus 1, close bracket.
Try the 3rd odd number before 10: 9, 7 and 5. That's 10 minus 5. The formula gives 10 minus, open bracket, 2 times 3, minus 1, close bracket. That is 10 minus 5, which equals 5. Correct!
steps: The nth odd number before even K is K minus, open bracket, 2 n minus 1, close bracket.
Substitute n equals 12. We get K minus, open bracket, 2 times 12, minus 1, close bracket, which is K minus 23.
Answer: K minus 23.

EXT_G5_WS_B2_001.q: In the given sum of addition, find the digits in place of A, B and C. A, 4, 8. Plus 3, 2, B. Plus 5, C, 1. Equals 1, 4, 7, 8.
options: A equals 6, B equals 0, C equals 9
A equals 8, B equals 9, C equals 0
A equals 6, B equals 9, C equals 0
A equals 6, B equals 9, C equals 1
hints: Look at each column separately, starting from the units column, the rightmost one.
